headline: Quarterly growth was mixed, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while others saw modest or slowing performance.
summary: Coforge led with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. LTM, Tech Mahindra and HCLTech delivered double‑digit growth, supported by AI‑driven deals. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% growth, the slowest among the majors. Wipro saw revenue rise 9.1% but profit fell, and OFSS posted modest 7% growth.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys AI revenue up 29% YoY and HCLTech AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, while Mphasis raised its outlook after strong dollar‑revenue growth.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins varied, with OFSS at a high 47.8% but many peers around 15‑18%, reflecting cost pressures.
